author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**


GO:0009231 | riboflavin biosynthetic process | IEA with IPR015865


* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPCC18.16c (fmn1)

* **Description of issue**

fmn1 is riboflavin kinase
 ATP + riboflavin = ADP + FMN + 2 H+.

so 
GO:0009398 | FMN biosynthetic process
would be correct.

A reference https://www.pombase.org/reference/PMID:12595258
title: GO:0009231	 riboflavin biosynthetic process IEA with IPR015865

author: ValWood
body: I think the reason this is annotated is that it is bifunctional in bacteria

author: sarach06
body:
